high_level_description: This image is a selfie taken outdoors on a sunny day. The person in the photo is wearing sunglasses, a black sleeveless shirt with camouflage-patterned straps of a backpack, and earphones. They have a beard and short hair. The background shows a street scene with trees, a building, and some flags hanging from a pole. There is also a signboard with text and images, though the details are not entirely clear. The text at the bottom of the image indicates that it is part of a trip to Tamil Nadu & Puducherry, dated 13 April 2018, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
